commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
export QA_USB_SERIAL="$SERIAL"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,re,subprocess,json
serial=os.environ["QA_USB_SERIAL"]
pkg="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"
uri="content://"+pkg+".gsmbinder"
def adb(*args,data=None):
    return subprocess.run(["adb","-s",serial,*args],input=data,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
def read(*args):
    p=adb(*args)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError("ADB_FAILED")
    return p.stdout
def safe():
    states=re.findall(r"mCallState=(\d+)",read("shell","dumpsys","telephony.registry"))
    assert states and all(s=="0" for s in states),"PHONE_NOT_IDLE"
    assert "Actual mode = MODE_NORMAL" in read("shell","dumpsys","audio"),"AUDIO_NOT_IDLE"
    assert read("shell","cmd","role","get-role-holders","--user","0","android.app.role.DIALER").strip()==pkg,"DIALER_CHANGED"
    assert "host_registered=true" in read("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","status"),"HOST_NOT_READY"
safe()
packages=read("shell","pm","list","packages","--user","0").splitlines()
assert "package:"+pkg in packages and "package:"+pkg+".s8lab" not in packages
print("ONE_MAIN_APP=true")
print("PHONE_IDLE=true")
print("GSM_HOST_READY=true")
a=read("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","qa_status")
assert "armed=true" in a or "armed=false" in a
print("QA_ARMED="+str("armed=true" in a).lower())
if "armed=true" in a:
    # Intentionally invalid payload: no number or goal, cannot create a callable task.
    p=adb("shell","-T","content","write","--uri",uri+"/qa/draft",data=json.dumps({"probe":"non-dialable-transport-test"}))
    if p.returncode or "Error" in p.stderr or "Exception" in p.stdout+p.stderr:
        print("ADB_UPLOAD_ACCEPTED=false")
        print("NO_CALLS=true")
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print("ADB_UPLOAD_ACCEPTED=true")
    ack=read("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","qa_commit","--arg","draft")
    assert "committed=false" in ack,"INVALID_PAYLOAD_NOT_REJECTED"
    print("INVALID_DRAFT_REJECTED=true")
    p=adb("exec-out","content","read","--uri",uri+"/qa/state")
    assert "qa_no_current_payload" in p.stdout+p.stderr or p.returncode!=0,"UNEXPECTED_ACTIVE_PAYLOAD"
    print("NO_ACTIVE_CALL_PAYLOAD=true")
else:
    print("TRANSPORT_PROBE_NOT_RUN_LEASE_EXPIRED=true")
safe()
print("NO_CALLS=true")
PY
commands.output:
ONE_MAIN_APP=true
PHONE_IDLE=true
GSM_HOST_READY=true
QA_ARMED=true
ADB_UPLOAD_ACCEPTED=true
INVALID_DRAFT_REJECTED=true
NO_ACTIVE_CALL_PAYLOAD=true
NO_CALLS=true
